card.title: TIGER I-H
card.flavorText: The Tiger I-H (also Panzerkampfwagen VI Tiger Ausf. H) was a TIGER I variant, a German heavy tank used in WWII by the axis forces. The Tiger I had a crew of 5 (commander, gunner, loader, driver, assistant driver) and was the first tank that mounted a 8.8 cm KwK 36 gun. The Tiger I was an outstanding design of its time but the production and the maintenance was very expensive and only 1347 were built.
